tagline: I build systems that have to work when they matter.

story.headline: I build systems that make real impact.
story.lead: I'm Anugrah, an AI/ML engineer in training. I care about outcomes, not just demos. A system earns its place when it helps someone make a better decision, move faster, or carry less friction. That is the standard I build toward.

principles.label: Outcome over demo
principles.text: The last 20 percent is the product.

principles.label: Interfaces are the system
principles.text: If the boundary is confusing, it is not finished.

principles.label: Boring layers earn trust
principles.text: Logs, retries, and permissions are features.

middle.headline: I care about the unglamorous middle.
middle.body: The middle is where a promising idea becomes something dependable. Auth, logs, retries, interfaces, failure states, and the small decisions that keep a system legible under pressure. I like that work because impact does not survive without it. That is the part I keep choosing.

flow.headline: Start with the problem. End with something that holds.

steps.label: PROBLEM
steps.text: Name the failure that actually matters, and who pays for it.

steps.label: CONSTRAINTS
steps.text: Respect latency, cost, trust, and the environment the system will live in.

steps.label: SYSTEM
steps.text: Build the smallest complete path from input to decision to feedback.

steps.label: IMPACT
steps.text: Check whether the person on the other side is better off.

flow.closing: The flow is problem → constraints → system → impact. The middle is not a detour. It is the path from problem to impact.
